# `ISSUE-ID` — Implementation plan

Template: placeholders and proposed status never establish approval. Keep one primary checklist; combine with the specification/verification for small issues.

Issue: `URL and number`
Specification: `relative link or combined section`
Verification: `relative link or combined section`
Status: Proposed
Branch / base: `branch and inspected base commit`
Updated: `date, Asia/Dhaka`

## Inspection and proposed approach

Record relevant code seams/current behavior, constraints, changes, dependencies and material tradeoffs. Include migration/recovery and UI sketches when the change needs them. Link broader requirements rather than copy them.

## Approval record

- Owner authorization: Pending
- Date and evidence: `actual owner message or review reference`
- Approved scope: `specification version/reference and boundaries`
- Material amendments: `changed scope and actual approval, if any`

Commit the approved plan before implementation. Unchanged approved scope survives agent handoff; do not infer acceptance or expanded authorization from it.

## Tasks

- [ ] T-01 — `concrete change and result`; covers `AC IDs`; depends on `tasks/gates`.
- [ ] T-02 — `meaningful verification/review`; covers `AC IDs`.

## Verification and delivery

Identify focused checks, required final checks, review criteria and external environments. Use the shared workflow's code/documentation requirements; record outcomes in verification. Commit coherent checkpoints, push verified milestones and keep pending criteria explicit. Merge/closure waits for required owner acceptance.

## Current checkpoint / handoff

- Approved scope: `reference`
- Commits and uncommitted changes: `actual state`
- Completed tasks: `IDs; primary checklist above`
- Next action: `specific next task`
- Verification: `record link and relevant results`
- Blockers/capabilities: `pending decisions/environments`

Update this checkpoint at meaningful boundaries. The next agent checks actual Git/code state before continuing.
